selectedCharacter: 12 — CLAY, terminal pixel pet; terracotta body and cream screen
scope: Four open chatbox layout concepts. Select layout before animation exploration.

candidates.name: BALON
candidates.detail: Concept label "C01 / BALON". A friendly cream speech balloon opening ABOVE and slightly LEFT of the pet, placed together in lower-right half of canvas. Panel about 540px wide and 365px high, parchment-cream flat surface with a thin warm dark outline and a small sharp stepped pixel-like tail at lower right pointing to pet. Pet stands OUTSIDE beneath the tail. Panel has generous airy padding. Small top-left header "OmarchyPet", close x top-right. Large dark greeting "Ne yapalım?" near upper left. Under it two understated plain text suggestion lines with small square leading icons: "GitHub’ı aç" and "Müzik çal". At bottom inside balloon one spacious outlined horizontal text-entry field with placeholder "Bir şey yapmamı iste..." and a dark terracotta square upward-arrow send button on right. Small footer "Enter gönder" and "Esc kapat". Flat cream, inviting and personal, not a terminal window. No message bubbles, no history sidebar. Clear visual speech connection between pet and box.
candidates.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished landscape 1536x1024 design study of the OPEN chatbox for OmarchyPet, a Linux desktop action assistant. Reference image is CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY, not a layout to copy. Preserve the chosen CLAY pet: crisp pixel-art squat terminal-shaped character, terracotta red border arms and feet, pale cream face, dark brown >_ symbols, distinctive upper-right notch. Show ONE small pet at about 90px high adjacent to its opened interface, never a giant mascot and never the reference sheet's extra poses. It should read as an actual usable desktop overlay at realistic scale, not a landing page or illustration. Flat charcoal #282828 desktop backdrop, quiet empty space; a minimal subdued bottom desktop bar may anchor placement. Render the UI extremely crisply, high-quality monospaced typography inspired by JetBrains Mono, aligned spacing, sharp corners and flat colors. Only PET is coarse pixel art, interface text and 1px rules are clean modern desktop UI. Terracotta #B6543B, cream #E8D7AD, brown #43362C, charcoal #1E1E1E are the palette. Each design is one distinct interaction layout. No gradient, no glow, no glassmorphism, no browser chrome, no mobile UI, no rounded SaaS cards, no blue, no diagrams, no giant explanatory text. Small muted monospace concept label in top left exactly as specified. Show freshly opened ready state, not a completed task, no fake model internals, latency stats or permissions. User must immediately understand where to type. Turkish UI strings exactly as specified; keep text sparse. Show a terracotta insertion cursor in the input. A small square close x control must be visible. This is visual concept work only, no animation or code.

candidates.name: KONSOL
candidates.detail: Concept label "C02 / KONSOL". A compact DARK TERMINAL WINDOW about 650px wide and 380px high placed center-right with pet standing outside at its lower LEFT corner. Pixel pet adjacent to real crisp square terminal UI. Window charcoal #161616, single-pixel terracotta border. Thin title bar with ">_ OmarchyPet" left, x right, subtle separator. Content is left-aligned monospace transcript-like prompt; top small muted line "Hazır." then one quiet instruction line "Bir komut yaz." Spacious black negative space. Lower section contains a strong horizontal dividing line and inline terminal prompt ">" in amber-cream followed by editable placeholder "Ne yapmamı istersin?" with visible block cursor. Under prompt thin bottom status strip labels "Enter çalıştır" and "Esc kapat". Suggestions are small plain inline text near top: "GitHub’ı aç  ·  Müzik çal". No rounded field container, no speech tail, no chat bubbles, no cream background, no boxed suggestion cards. Professional minimal command terminal with readable hierarchy.

candidates.name: SERIT
candidates.detail: Concept label "C03 / SERIT". A VERY LOW AND WIDE HORIZONTAL COMMAND BAR, about 900px wide by 115px high, floating near bottom center; pet immediately to its LEFT at the same height. This must be dramatically wider and shallower than a chat window. Two horizontal zones within one sharp-corner cream-edged dark bar. Top 70px is one large input: terracotta > prompt at left, clean cream placeholder "Ne yapalım?" and text cursor, small square terracotta send arrow at far right beside tiny x. Bottom 40px a very subtle divider and three compact text shortcut items "GitHub’ı aç", "Müzik çal", "Klasör oluştur", evenly spaced on left, tiny "Enter" hint on far right. An extremely small "OmarchyPet" label can sit just above bar aligned left. No greeting block, no transcript, no tall panel, no floating bubbles, no vertical layout. Desktop command launcher feeling, fast unobtrusive horizontal composition, strong negative space above. Pet acts as the visual left endpoint of bar.

candidates.name: DEFTER
candidates.detail: Concept label "C04 / DEFTER". A TALL NARROW CREAM CONVERSATION NOTE PANEL about 370px wide by 570px high, floating on right side of desktop with pet standing just to its lower LEFT, visually independent of panel. Panel sharp rectangular with a 6px solid terracotta vertical binding strip along LEFT edge, flat pale cream writing surface, muted thin brown horizontal rules only where useful. Header "OmarchyPet" and x, below a small terracotta ready marker and "Hazır". Upper content one small assistant message "Sen söyle, ben yapayım." aligned left WITHOUT speech bubble container. Beneath it two vertically stacked compact ruled action rows each with small simple square icon and right arrow: "GitHub’ı aç" and "Müzik çal". Plenty of blank conversation space. Bottom composer is a dark brown full-width inset writing block about 105px high with cream placeholder "Bir şey yapmamı iste..." at top-left and small terracotta square send arrow bottom-right. Tiny footer "Enter gönder · Shift+Enter yeni satır". Emphasize slim vertical persistent-conversation shape, editorial notebook feel, no speech tail, no terminal commands, no paper texture, no realistic notebook or physical binding.
